newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco diesel basis steady in Group Three.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco diesel basis steady in Group Three.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot diesel fuel differentials were unchanged in Group Three on Thursday after moving steadily lower through the week, traders said.
Unleaded gasoline basis also was steady in Chicago after moving higher on refiner buying pegged to Amoco and Citgo earlier in the week, traders said.
With the buying interest receding from the market, spot prices were left to track easing NYMEX unleaded and heating oil futures, traders said.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was talked 5.0/4.75 cents a gallon under NYMEX February heating oil, with high sulphur 8.25 cents a gallon under the print.
Chicago prompt low sulphur diesel was talked 5.0/4.75 cents a gallon under the print, with high sulphur steady at bids 7.0 cents a gallon under.

Unleaded gasoline was bid 3.25 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and 0.25 cent over the print in Chicago, with prices tracking a nearly 1.75 cents a gallon drop in NYMEX front-month unleaded.
